claims.text: Akhtar and colleagues distinguish contamination sources, transport pathways and effects on water systems, and argue that no single criterion characterizes water quality.
claims.evidence_quote: At present, there is no single criterion for any water resources that can characterize water quality.
claims.locator: Supplied PDF pp. 2–5, Figure 1; discussion p. 27.
claims.permitted_use: Keep groundwater demand, water quality and ecological or health effects as separate claims requiring appropriate observations.
claims.prohibited_inference: A projected reduction in groundwater withdrawal demonstrates contamination reduction, safe water or aquifer recovery.
contrary_or_qualifying_evidence: Multiple sources and interacting contaminants complicate attribution.
This is a broad review; its cited local measurements were not independently inspected.
claims.missing_dependency: Cerrillos-specific withdrawal, discharge, contaminant, receptor and monitoring evidence for any substantive environmental-effect claim.

claims.text: The Nature-Based Solutions section connects ecosystem interventions with governance, local knowledge and protection of livelihoods; its proposed scaling measures include zoning and institutional coordination.
claims.evidence_quote: Municipal zoning regulations should be updated to mandate green infrastructure in new developments and protect ecologically sensitive areas.
claims.locator: Gauto Espinola and Llaguno Ribadeneira, Nature-Based Solutions, printed pp. 157–161 (PDF 158–162), especially p. 161.
claims.permitted_use: Explain why judging a proposed environmental intervention requires attention to ecological functions, implementation conditions and affected people.
claims.prohibited_inference: Nora authored every section; the cooling redesign is nature-based; Amazonian interventions prove benefits or policy failure in Cerrillos.
contrary_or_qualifying_evidence: This section recommends actions and cites outside studies; it is not one intervention trial.
Nora Libertun de Duren identifies data/evaluation gaps in her conclusion, printed p. 173.
Ecology, institutions and scales differ from the Chilean case.
claims.missing_dependency: Original effect studies for numerical NbS claims; Cerrillos original instruments and site evidence for case conclusions.

claims.permitted_use: Ask which operating assumptions and affected livelihoods are included when comparing technologies; preserve rival explanations.

claims.text: Hettiarachchi and colleagues propose organic-waste buyback; their Cajicá and South African examples illustrate settings for adaptation rather than demonstrate the complete proposed model.
claims.evidence_quote: However, to our understanding, organic waste buyback is not practiced anywhere in its entirety.
claims.locator: Supplied PDF p. 7, section 4; pp. 9 and 11–13.
claims.permitted_use: Distinguish an operating precursor program, its maintenance and financing conditions, and a proposed extension whose benefits remain conditional.
claims.prohibited_inference: The paper experimentally proves organic buyback works, or political turnover actually ended the Cajicá program.
contrary_or_qualifying_evidence: Cajicá relies on municipal collection, training and a vendor; the proposal changes its financing and collection model.
Reported growth in recovery coexists with growth in per-person waste generation.
claims.missing_dependency: Original municipal program records and evaluation of the proposed buyback model for causal or performance conclusions.

claims.evidence_quote: the final number of conversion companies under the comparative investigation amounted to 35.
claims.locator: Supplied PDF pp. 6–10, methods, Figures 8–10 and Table 1.
claims.permitted_use: Maintain distinct technical, commercial, regulatory and organizational explanations for a redesign, without inferring motives from its timing.

contrary_or_qualifying_evidence: The frame was 364 firms; 41 participated initially and 35 entered the comparison.
Reported changes concern both adoption and intensity of use; these are different measures.
Safety requirements may be substantive rather than avoidable bureaucracy.
claims.missing_dependency: Cerrillos company and administrative records establishing reasons for the redesign; microdata and comparison design for causal survey claims.
